label: Figure 3b
caption: Figure 3b Orography Factor O for cliffs and escarpments (interpolation between curves may be used)
description: This is a line chart titled "Figure 3b Orography Factor O for cliffs and escarpments (interpolation between curves may be used)". The vertical axis is marked in steps of 0.05 from 1.00 up to 1.40, and the horizontal axis is labelled "X/Lu" running from -1 to 2.5 in steps of 0.5. Three curves are plotted, each peaking at X/Lu = 0 and falling away on both sides toward 1.00. The upper curve peaks at 1.35 and is labelled "Steep slope < 1/3.3"; the middle curve peaks at 1.20 and is labelled "Moderate slope = 1/5"; the lower curve peaks at 1.10 and is labelled "Shallow slope ≤ 1/10". In the top-right corner is an inset cross-sectional sketch of a ground profile comprising a flat lower section, a vertical cliff face, and a slope rising to a flat top, with a shaded rectangle positioned above the crest of the slope. The inset carries a vertical dimension z marking the height of the cliff face, a vertical dimension 0.5z marking the rise of the slope, a horizontal dimension Lu, markers -X and +X, a horizontal dimension 1.5Ld above the flat top, and the note "Orography significant in shaded area". The rotated label for the vertical axis at the far left edge is partly cut off and not clearly legible.
